question.text: Section IX of the PPM template deals with Conflicts of Interest. The chapter specifies that conflicts must be disclosed as arising at multiple levels. Which of the following is NOT listed as a level of conflict disclosure in Section IX?

answer.text: At the level of employee of the management entity
At the level of service providers of the Fund/Scheme
At the level of the Sponsor/Manager group entity, in relation to various schemes managed by the Sponsor/Manager
At the level of SEBI registered Research Analysts covering the investee companies

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5 (Section IX disclosures), conflicts must be disclosed at: (a) employee of management entity, (b) service providers of the Fund, (c) Manager, (d) Sponsor, (e) investor, (f) governance body members, (g) Sponsor/Manager group entity (across schemes). Third-party SEBI registered Research Analysts are NOT a named conflict layer — their role is external. The Trap: Research Analyst level sounds plausible but is not in the SEBI-prescribed list. Also requires disclosures on warehousing and co-investments. Cross-Exam Context: XV (Research Analyst) exam tests RA conflicts. XIX-C tests AIF-specific conflict disclosures, which are managed at fund / sponsor group level. Manager's Pro-Tip: Build a Conflicts Register updated quarterly — capture related-party transactions, warehousing, and co-investments. At PPM audit time, the register is your evidence that Section IX disclosures are accurate and current.
